title: Statistical report on the health of children in Hungary in the 2010s
title_hu: Statisztikai jelentés a gyermekegészség állapotáról Magyarországon a 21. század második évtizedében
summary_en: Hajdú compiles a statistical report on the health of children in Hungary in the 2010s, covering mortality, low-birth-weight rates, hospitalisation, vaccination coverage, and BMI distributions across age groups and county-level geography. The report sets a quantitative baseline against which subsequent child-health policy interventions can be measured, and surfaces persistent gaps between high-income (Pest, Western Hungary) and low-income (Eastern Hungary, Northeastern counties) regions.
policy_relevance: Direct input for Hungarian child-health policy (EMMI, NEAK, NNK Public Health Centre): the county-level baselines identify priority districts for paediatric public-health interventions, and the time-series trends inform the calibration of national child-health targets. Standard reference for Hungarian child-poverty analyses and EU equity-fund applications targeting child welfare.
